content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The human's account does not establish that Aro fixed the porch speaker.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"In that shared morning, we talked through the porch speaker with Aro.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Aro introduced themself using only that name.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"I received the human's quiet-morning account through my voice body on 2026-09-17.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record the morning's calendar date.","support":[],"basis":"unknown","facet":"context"},{"text":"Aro changed the lantern battery.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"After that change, the porch speaker stopped buzzing.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The human reported that we had not tested whether the two events were connected.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The apparent connection could have been coincidence.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"We enjoyed hearing the birds during the quiet pause, according to the human's account.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human reported that nothing else was repaired or demonstrated that morning.","support":[16],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record a later test resolving whether Aro fixed the speaker.","support":[],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"},{"text":"My receiving voice body has no physical sensors or actuators.","support":[],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"}]}
